Tests that a request is rejected when budget is exceeded

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using LiterLlm;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
try
{
using var client = LiterLlmConverter.CreateClientFromJson("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"budget\":{\"enforcement\":\"hard\",\"global_limit\":0.0}}");
var result = await client.ChatAsync(new ChatCompletionRequest { Messages = new List<Message>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Message>("{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}", ConfigOptions)! }, Model = "gpt-4" });
}
catch (Exception error)
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine($"{error.GetType().Name}: {error.Message}");
}
```
